candidates.additional_monthly_candidate: Repeat past 12 fast-EMA differences; invert EMA for actual-change forecast

selection: Per dataset and track, equal-horizon relative MAE on past inner origins; null always eligible; min success .8
evaluation: Only outer origins with all five labels present, plus latest wholly unscored origin
aggregation: Equal-dataset average of within-dataset skill; stocks and nonfinancial separate; no pooled physical-unit errors
uncertainty: Paired moving-block MAE ranges at lengths 1/2/4; stock panel resamples same time blocks across all assets; fixed baseline normalizers

independence.reason: Existing project stock caches and public teaching datasets; historical exposure, selection and vintage effects remain.

prospective_plan.status: specification only, not started or scheduled
prospective_plan.cohort: Same six stocks; first 60 common completed-session forecast origins after collection begins
prospective_plan.procedure: Keep TS09 model menu, seeds, features and training budget; select by six earlier origins 20 sessions apart at first origin and every 200 common sessions; refit at every origin
prospective_plan.requirements: Store newly issued forecast and input-vintage hashes before outcomes; score only after all five outcomes mature; no retrospective replacement or outer-score model promotion
prospective_plan.success_rule: No paper_validated promotion from this historical audit; require a separately reviewed prospective acceptance rule before deployment
